finalists.label: Phyllodes Tumor
finalists.why: It has the most specific and decisive findings for it, including a well-defined mass with multiple pleomorphic calcifications and a 2-year history of a growing, painless nodule.

finalists.label: Sclerosing Adenosis
finalists.why: It has a specific finding for it, multiple pleomorphic calcifications that had increased in number compared with a prior study, with no findings against it.
